rv.q: For refreshing summertime theatrical fun, do not miss the expert comedy The Play That Goes Wrong at the Keegan Theatre!
Without exception, everyone excels at making a series of catastrophic mistakes look utterly professional.

cn.t: Critics praise this frenetically funny farce that gleefully subverts murder mystery tropes with physical slapstick and verbal wit, comparing it favorably to "Noises Off" for its madcap comedic escapism.
